## Projects
1. GPU-Accelerated ML Pipeline (HPC|CUDA|cuML|cuDF): RAPIDS pipelines (cuDF preprocessing, cuML training), multi-fold speedups over CPU
2. Quantum ML for Network Security (Quantum ML|Network Security|Python): quantum kernels for one-class intrusion detection on CICIoT2023/UNSW-NB15; PSO-tuned RFF surrogate vs exact fidelity kernel; no advantage over RBF SVM
3. Quantum-Inspired Decentralized IoT Anomaly Detection (IoT Security|Anomaly Detection|Swarm): fidelity-density detector + swarm peer corroboration; ROC-AUC 0.9706/0.8758; 50-node NS-3 (3-of-3 delivery, 10.8424 ms latency)
4. Smart Navigation Assistant for Visually Impaired (AI|Flutter): real-time assistive navigation with LLM, CV object detection, distance estimation, TTS guidance
5. Student Mental Health Detection System (ML|NLP): RoBERTa & Gemma transformer for sentiment analysis + CLI inference tool
